summary: V3 Image Generation Integration - All tests passed. Fixed critical bug in spell_prompts.py (duplicate prompt assignment causing 'tarot_emblem' undefined error). Backend generates header_image and tarot_card_image via Gemini when skip_images=false. Frontend GrimoirePage correctly wired to render generated images.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V3 image generation is now working. Fixed bug in spell_prompts.py where duplicate prompt assignment (lines 989-999) was outside the else block, causing 'tarot_emblem' undefined error. The async job endpoint POST /api/ai/generate-spell-job with skip_images=false now correctly generates header_image and tarot_card_image via Gemini. Quick tier auto-skips images. Catherine alias resolves to Katherine in persona_config. Border files use -alt.png versions (real images 500KB+, non-alt are 111-byte stubs).

When IMAGE_PROVIDER env not set, defaults to GEMINI

Job completes with header_image (1.7MB) and tarot_card_image (1.7MB)
PERSONA_BORDER_URLS in OrnateElements.js uses cathleen-border-alt.png, kate-border-alt.png, theresa-border-alt.png
